a letter for you
Hey Riyana! 🫶🏻 HAPPY BIRTHDAY MY GIRLLLLL!! You have no idea how much you mean to me ✨ OMGGG you are getting old lolllll. I think this is my first letter to you. Honestly I don't want to write a cringe letter to you but at the same time I can't help it (I mean isn't it the whole point of it?) 😂 So forgive me (I'm saying this in advance btw). Okay here goes the cringe part: you have always been that friend who looks out for me, who hypes me up to take part in things, someone I can tell everything to without being judged — okay let me rephrase that, you DO judge me a lot, but in a friendly way 😁 — a shoulder I can always rely on (aghhh that was cringe wasn't it, it's okay, adjust). You are all I can ask for ✨ okay yeah that's it, that's the cringe part done. I'm saying this because it's your birthday (I mean it though). You are swag 😎, now you better be happy cause that's like one of the biggest compliments you can get, and also you are sigma, I just never said it hehehe. Just so you know you are unique and wonderfully made, Riyana (dang now I feel like some philosopher). I will always love the time when we just sit in class and laugh at random things, especially during physics class 🤣 (and roasting Resmi ma'am, like of course). Not gonna lie, we act like some critic correcting her teaching lol. You are also one of the most brilliant girls I know (I mean you got second rank, that's like crazyyyy). A day in school without you next to me in class is something I CANNOT survive, it's like missing the cherry on top of the cake, you know? I really hope we do memorymaxxing for the rest of our lives, and I'm so looking forward to making crazy, silly memories with you this year :) And once again, Happy Birthday Riyannnnnnnaaaaaa 💗🫶🏻
— Erin The Swag Olivia

Happy Birthday!

Here's to more memories, more inside jokes, and more us.

I love you so much, Riyana.
